title: California Coast Road Trip
subtitle: San Diego → Santa Clarita → Lancaster
summary: Five hotel nights along the coast, followed by a family stay in Lancaster.
guidelines: Keep each day flexible around naps, meals, and traffic

days.title: San Diego → La Jolla
days.label: Arrival & waterfront
days.hotel: Embassy Suites by Hilton San Diego La Jolla (shortlist)
days.note: Landing time is unknown, so keep the downtown portion flexible. No Zoo visit.

items.name: San Diego downtown & waterfront
items.detail: Embarcadero waterfront, Seaport Village or Gaslamp-area sightseeing; select based on arrival time

items.name: Balboa Park
items.detail: Walk the gardens and architecture rather than committing to museum tickets

items.name: La Jolla coastal stroll
items.detail: La Jolla Cove or La Jolla Shores, depending on daylight and stroller access
items.map: La Jolla Cove San Diego CA

items.name: Check in and wind down
items.detail: Aim to finish by 8–9 PM; earlier if needed for the baby

days.title: La Jolla → San Clemente
days.label: Bay Club & slow coastal drive
days.hotel: Holiday Inn Express San Clemente North Beach Area (shortlist)
days.note: Bay Club must be early enough to return to the La Jolla hotel, shower, pack and check out. Confirm a late checkout in advance.

items.name: Bay Club Carmel Valley
items.detail: Childcare schedule begins 8:30 AM Thursday; membership and reservation eligibility must be confirmed
items.map: Bay Club Carmel Valley 12000 Carmel Country Rd San Diego CA

items.name: Return to La Jolla hotel
items.detail: Shower, pack and check out before driving north

items.name: Coastal drive north
items.detail: Optional short break in Encinitas or Carlsbad; do not force extra stops

items.name: San Clemente neighborhoods
items.detail: Drive through Talega, Marblehead and coastal residential streets

items.name: Avenida Del Mar & pier
items.detail: Walkable downtown, dining and ocean views

items.name: 24 Hour Fitness — San Clemente
items.detail: 110 Avenida La Pata; optional evening workout if timing permits
items.map: 24 Hour Fitness 110 Avenida La Pata San Clemente CA

days.gym: Bay Club Carmel Valley · AM; 24 Hour Fitness San Clemente · optional PM

days.title: San Clemente → Huntington Beach
days.label: Laguna, neighborhoods & shopping
days.hotel: Hyatt Regency Huntington Beach Resort and Spa (shortlist)
days.note: Do not attempt every mall. Choose at most one major shopping stop and one or two neighborhood drives.

items.name: Laguna Beach
items.detail: Heisler Park and the village center; coastal views and a short walk

items.name: Mission Viejo / Laguna Niguel
items.detail: Residential neighborhood evaluation and The Shops at Mission Viejo if desired
items.map: The Shops at Mission Viejo CA

items.name: Irvine neighborhood drive
items.detail: Turtle Rock / Woodbridge; Irvine Spectrum only if time allows

items.name: Costa Mesa shopping
items.detail: South Coast Plaza optional instead of Irvine Spectrum
items.map: South Coast Plaza Costa Mesa CA

items.name: Huntington Beach check-in
items.detail: Beach walk or Pacific City before dinner

items.name: 24 Hour Fitness — Huntington Beach
items.detail: Atlanta Ave Super-Sport, 9051 Atlanta Ave; Friday listed closing 9 PM
items.map: 24 Hour Fitness 9051 Atlanta Ave Huntington Beach CA

days.gym: 24 Hour Fitness Huntington Beach · optional evening

days.title: Huntington Beach → Redondo Beach
days.label: Cerritos, Long Beach & Palos Verdes
days.hotel: Redondo Beach Hotel, Tapestry Collection by Hilton (shortlist)
days.note: This is the fullest driving day. Keep Cerritos brief; prioritize Palos Verdes in daylight and arrive in Redondo before evening.

items.name: Cerritos residential & retail loop
items.detail: Los Cerritos Center and nearby neighborhoods; brief visit

items.name: Long Beach — Belmont Shore / Naples
items.detail: 2ND & PCH, coastal neighborhoods and lunch

items.name: Palos Verdes Estates & Rolling Hills Estates
items.detail: Malaga Cove, neighborhoods and legal public scenic viewpoints; check road restrictions
items.map: Malaga Cove Plaza Palos Verdes Estates CA

items.name: Redondo Beach / Riviera Village
items.detail: Check in, beach promenade and optional dinner

days.title: Redondo Beach → Santa Clarita
days.label: Bay Club, Valley & Valencia
days.note: Bay Club Redondo Beach has no childcare; El Segundo offers childcare subject to membership access and a reservation. Mission Hills 24 Hour Fitness is en route if another workout is desired.

items.name: Bay Club El Segundo
items.detail: Recommended for childcare: Sunday childcare window 8:00 AM–1:30 PM. Shower at the club after checkout if convenient.
items.map: Bay Club El Segundo 2250 Park Pl El Segundo CA

items.name: Alternative: Bay Club Redondo Beach
items.detail: Closer to the hotel, but no on-site childcare
items.map: Bay Club Redondo Beach 819 North Harbor Dr CA

items.name: Sherman Oaks
items.detail: Residential streets south of Ventura Blvd, shops and Sherman Oaks Galleria

items.name: Studio City
items.detail: Ventura Blvd retail, quiet residential blocks and a short park stop

items.name: 24 Hour Fitness — Mission Hills
items.detail: 10400 Sepulveda Blvd; closest practical 24 Hour Fitness on the northbound route; optional
items.map: 24 Hour Fitness 10400 Sepulveda Blvd Mission Hills CA

items.name: Valencia check-in
items.detail: Valencia Town Center area; early dinner and rest
items.map: Westfield Valencia Town Center Santa Clarita CA

days.gym: Bay Club El Segundo · AM; Mission Hills 24 Hour Fitness · optional

days.title: Santa Clarita → Lancaster
days.label: Home-search morning
days.note: No fixed lodging address is stored in the public trip plan. Keep the afternoon/evening flexible.

items.name: Valencia and Bridgeport
items.detail: Drive neighborhood streets, parks, daily-shopping corridors and schools from the outside

items.name: Stevenson Ranch
items.detail: Residential drive and grocery / retail conveniences

items.name: Optional local fitness
items.detail: No 24 Hour Fitness in Santa Clarita itself; use hotel fitness room or a run instead

items.name: Drive to Lancaster
items.detail: Arrive at family home with a buffer ahead of Thanksgiving

days.gym: Optional hotel gym or morning run; no 24 Hour Fitness in Santa Clarita

days.title: Lancaster & departure
days.label: Family time / Thanksgiving
days.note: Thanksgiving is Thursday, November 26. Confirm flight and BUR car return times; family address is intentionally omitted.

items.name: Stay with family
items.detail: Flexible activities; Thanksgiving Nov 26

items.name: Return rental car and fly home
items.detail: Assumes departure from Hollywood Burbank (BUR); verify airport, traffic, and return instructions

bookings.title: Verify arrival and departure flight details
bookings.description: Especially SAN arrival time and whether Dec 1 departure is BUR.

bookings.title: Reserve one-way rental car
bookings.description: Pickup SAN · Nov 18; return BUR · Dec 1 (pending flight verification); arrange infant car seat.

bookings.title: Book La Jolla hotel
bookings.description: Nov 18–19; request late checkout on Nov 19.

bookings.title: Confirm Bay Club access and childcare
bookings.description: Check the wife's California club access, guest entitlement, infant membership eligibility, and book Nov 19/22 childcare.

bookings.title: Check 24 Hour Fitness entry privileges
bookings.description: Confirm visiting-guest access and holiday-adjusted hours.
